sloka: लक्ष्मणस्य आत्मनः चैव रामः तेन अकरोज् जटाः ।दीर्घबाहुर्नरव्याघ्रो जटिलत्व मधारयत् ॥२-५२-६९॥
transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya ātmanaḥ caiva rāmaḥ tena akaroj jaṭāḥ ।dīrghabāhurnaravyāghro jaṭilatva madhārayat ॥2-52-69॥

translations.english: The longarmed Rama, the best of men, put on locks of matted hair. As the two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana stood dressed in bark wearing crowns of matted hair, they resembled two resplendent ascetics.
